bounded_validation.method: Decode route_after operation batches, merge adjacent equal-factory nodes, build a projected post-current-service fleet from saved vehicle_info carrying_items and locked destinations, then call the existing independent dpdp_feasibility.validate over saved unallocated plus ongoing items.

bounded_validation.scope: Read-only artifact validation, not a new simulator or Java run. The real-model adapter regressions are separate.

conclusion.allowed_reassignment: Before pickup, reassignment is legal if the complete remaining plan preserves capacity, LIFO, precedence, current operations, and locked destination factory/arrival. The validator has no suffix assignment lock.
conclusion.disallowed_omission: A previously accepted, undelivered item must remain in the executable published remaining plan unless its operation is in the preserved current visit.
conclusion.required_change: Satisfying this stronger contract requires changing publication commitment semantics or constraining private search. Promoting a hidden private suffix changes isDelay dispatch; retaining the old vehicle plan changes the selected solution; forbidding reassignment changes search. None is an unchanged-baseline adapter correction.
conclusion.recommendation: Keep the accepted-order guard, retain invalid results and null scores, add regressions proving both saved outputs are rejected, and do not run expensive full references before an explicit integration/publication design revision.
